passages.text: The ocean gradually slants, slopes, and inclines, with no abrupt precipice. In the same way in this teaching and training the penetration to enlightenment comes from gradual training, progress, and practice, not abruptly.
passages.note: Impatience with progress; growth comes gradually, not suddenly

passages.text: The ocean has just one taste, the taste of salt. In the same way, this teaching and training has one taste, the taste of freedom.
passages.note: Purpose of the spiritual path is freedom
